newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S VIERA AND UPSON GIVEN THREE-GAME BANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S VIERA AND UPSON GIVEN THREE-GAME BANS.

text.p: Arsenal's French international midfielder Patrick Vieira and Mathew Upson have been suspended for three matches after being sent off in a pre-season friendly against PSV Eindhoven last month.
The club said the bans were imposed after the F.A. received official notification from the Dutch authorities.
They start on August 25, forcing both players to miss the north London derby with Tottenham. Arsenal said they had appealed in Vieira's case.
English Football Association (F.A.) spokesman Steve Double confirmed that the club had sent a video of the incident involving the Frenchman as part of their appeal.
"We have forwarded it for the Dutch FA to pass on to the referee to see if he wants to reconsider in that case," said Double.
Vieira was sent off for reacting to a foul by Tomek Iwan near the end of Arsenal's 1-0 defeat.
The F.A. handed Arsenal a 50,000 pounds ($78,900) suspended fine last week for their poor disciplinary record last season.
